reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established principles that a more uniform mixing of components can alter the d-band structure and enhance catalytic properties, though there are minor uncertainties regarding the exact quantitative relationship.
reasons.testability: A straightforward experiment contrasting rapid quenching with slow cooling, combined with structural and catalytic characterizations, can decisively confirm or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a clear explanation and experimentally verifiable approach to improving high-entropy alloy catalysts by controlling atomic-scale mixing, which is of high relevance to researchers in this field.
